description:
The Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Developer will support the Vanguard 2025 contract in the Diplomatic Technology (DT) Bureau of US Department of State.  The Microsoft 365 & Power Platform Developer will report to the Vanguard Program Management Office and will assist in the daily application management, administration, and project-oriented support of relevant frontend SharePoint tenant environments and Power Platform workspaces.  This is not a backend infrastructure/architecture/hardware/server administrator position.
 This role is hybrid and requires at least 1 day per week onsite in Washington, DC.  
 Description of Duties: 
 Design, develop, implement, and maintain Microsoft 365 and Power Platform solutions to enhance business processes, knowledge management, collaboration, and operational efficiency across the organization.
 Serve as a primary point of contact and provide Tier 1–3 technical support for SharePoint Online and Power Platform service requests, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, user assistance, and application support.
 Design, configure, and maintain SharePoint Online production portal sites, site collections, pages, libraries, lists, metadata, content types, navigation, permissions, and other out-of-the-box features. Perform routine and complex configuration updates, manage site-level user access and group permissions, and maintain portal content under the direction of government leadership.
 Develop, enhance, and maintain low-code business applications, customized forms, and automated processes using Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Forms, and Microsoft Lists, including workflows, approvals, notifications, data collection, and document routing.
 Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, including data transformation, modeling, visualizations, publishing, and scheduled refreshes to support operational reporting and data-driven decision-making.
 Support the full solution lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, and enhancements, while following established governance policies, security requirements, and best practices.
 Collaborate with government stakeholders, business users, and cross-functional technical teams, including RPA, database, and data engineering teams, to identify business needs, improve processes, evaluate automation opportunities, and support solution integration.
 Develop and maintain technical and user documentation, including governance procedures, standard operating procedures, user guides, quick reference materials, requirements documentation, test plans, and other artifacts supporting solution development, administration, and Tier 2–3 requests.
 Provide technical leadership, guidance, and knowledge sharing to team members, assist with complex technical issues, and promote SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform best practices.
 

 Required Education & Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a related technical discipline, with a minimum of five years of relevant experience in SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform environments; masters degree in a related technical discipline with a minimum of three years of relevant experience; may accept additional experience in lieu of degree.  
 Proficiency in SharePoint Online architecture, design, administration, and out-of-the-box configuration, including sites, pages, libraries, lists, metadata, navigation, and permissions.
 Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps applications and forms, Power Automate workflows, and Power BI dashboards and reports.
 Working knowledge of JSON for SharePoint formatting and Power Platform solutions.
 Experience providing Tier 1–3 technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution in an IT or customer-facing environment.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements, document solutions, and collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams.
 Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams; familiarity with Visio and Microsoft Project.
 Required Clearance: 
 US Citizenship.
 Ability to obtain and maintain a secret clearance.
 Must obtain an interim secret clearance prior to starting work. 
 Desired Experience, Skills & Attributes: 
 Familiarity with Microsoft Dataverse, including data modeling, security roles, and integration with Power Apps and Power Automate.
 Experience with SQL, relational databases, or data integration technologies; familiarity with Azure Databricks is a plus.
 Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), including Power Automate Desktop or enterprise automation solutions.
 Experience with business process analysis, optimization, and integration using Microsoft Power Platform connectors and external data sources.
 CompTIA Security+ or relevant Microsoft certifications, particularly in Power Platform technologies.
